ai_summary: Bajaj Housing Finance Limited reported robust financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, driven by significant year-over-year growth in total income and profit after tax, primarily due to a substantial expansion of its loan book. The unaudited results received an unmodified limited review opinion, indicating sound financial reporting, with no material red flags observed; however, a sequential increase in impairment on financial instruments warrants monitoring.
